Host-Side sa build-exe / sa test Overview

Sla's build-exe, sab workspace, and test all delegate their compilation artifacts to the SA host's commands of the same name to complete. After reading this page you can understand which parameters the host commands accept, and thereby know who ultimately consumes the options passed through to sa sla ....

sa build-exe

Takes the input (.sa or a SAB artifact), verifies it with the Referee, then emits it as a native executable. The default optimization level is --release-small.

# 宿主原生用法（sci 仓库）
./zig-out/bin/sa build-exe examples/hello.sa -o hello

# 由 sla 委派时：sa build-exe <.sla-cache/sab/xxx.sab> [透传参数...]
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla build-exe src/main.sla -o bin/app --release-fast --jobs 4
Common parametersDescription
-o <path>The output executable path; when omitted, it is derived from the input path with a platform suffix added (Windows is .exe).
--release-fast / --release-smallSelect the optimization level, corresponding to LLVM O3 and O1 respectively.
-g / --no-debugEnable / disable debug information.
--jobs <n|auto>Parallelism; auto is decided by the host.
-p, --package / --project-rootWorkspace member and root directory selection.
--no-incremental, --ci, etc.General compilation options such as incremental cache switches.

sa check

Flattens and verifies .sa / .sab files, without codegen or linking. --emit-sab <path> writes a verified program as a .sab binary (the input may be .sa or .sab).

sa check /tmp/main.sa
sa check --emit-sab /tmp/main.sab /tmp/main.sa

sa test

Compiles and runs the tests in a source file, supporting filtering and debugging switches.

# 宿主原生用法
sa test tests/foo.test.sa --filter foo_case --trace-panic

# 由 sla 委派时：sa test <托管 SAB> [透传参数...] --jobs auto
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test src/main.sla --trace-panic
Common parametersDescription
--filter <pattern>Inclusion filter; may be given multiple times.
--skip <pattern>Exclusion filter; may be given multiple times.
--exactMatch by full name exactly rather than by substring.
--ignored / --include-ignoredRun only ignored tests / run them together with the ignored ones.
--listList test names only, without running.
--compile-onlyCompile only, without running.
--trace-panic (alias --test-debug)Output trace information on panic.
--affectedAffected-tests mode.
--jobs <n|auto>Parallelism.
NoteWhen invoked via sa sla test, --filter is consumed at the plugin layer (used to trim tests and determine the cache path) and is not passed verbatim to the child process; the rest, such as --trace-panic and --skip, are passed through.
WarningWhich sa executable is used for delegation is resolved by the plugin (SA_EXE → $SCI_ROOT/zig-out/bin → the plugin's directory → PATH). If results look wrong after you have modified sci locally, first confirm that delegation is not going to an old installed version; set SA_EXE if necessary.
